facts: Upstream membership is not proof of local CUDA12.8/A40 execution, bug freedom, or strict semantic suitability.
rules: Do not count launch variants, random seeds, shapes, or stages of a parent program as independent workloads.
Freeze source/data/adapter hashes and numerical domain before any new-cohort model calls.
Keep deterministic upfront exclusions with reason; never discard tasks because generated candidates fail or are slow.
Record old six as development tasks. Newly admitted tasks are prospective; family overlaps remain reported.
No change to source semantics, error tolerance, or candidate selection after viewing confirmation results.

planned_if_all_30_accepted.gpu_execution: existing A40 only; no cross-GPU portability conclusion
